vocabulary_descriptions.small_pallet: Definition: in this miniature warehouse, a "small pallet" is a flat gray square platform with a grid-like slatted surface, lying on the floor. It may look like a ventilation grille or a drain cover. Small colored cubes may sit on top of it.
vocabulary_descriptions.note: Plan A (EXP111 DESIGN §3), fixed 2026-11-15 before running. Written from the object's appearance (dev diagnosis: Qwen called it 'grate'/'ventilation grille'); contains no location. English for every query (EXP110 rule: only the query string changes language). Prepended to the unchanged prompt.
